summary: I closed the last loose end the record was carrying: the correction of the two-gate behaviour entry had registered an affected-use gap against the adverse-phase question, and the final revision of that question's interpretation now answers it with the evidence rather than with a note. The affected use was that interpretation's reliance on revision 1 of the entry; its comparisons and conclusion are untouched — the overlap prediction still came back violated with all twenty trials as valid witnesses, each ending its confirmations at the leader's lease with no competing leader in the window — and the refinement the correction carries is carried by the sibling receipt, cited here with the compatibility reasoning that makes the join legitimate: same construction, same operands, one variable changed, namely pre-vote disabled so that the higher-term candidacy this run could not produce does form. Read together they attribute the separation to the peers' refusal to vote while they still have the leader in view, released only when their own heartbeat timers expire, with pre-vote as an additional gate that stops the candidacy from forming at all; the counterevidence item that said the attribution was unavailable is replaced by the honest residual that the attribution now rests on a configuration which is legal but not the captured default, alongside the same limits of one cluster shape, a constructed history and no application read. The behaviour entry is now cited at its corrected revision. That leaves the run's record complete: three execution-grounded findings with their receipts, witnesses and scoped limits — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft, the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum and, under per-node timers, can accompany committed state the confirming leader never applied, and the membership change that installs a voter immediately and can strand a single-voter cluster — four refuted suspicions and one excluded cause with the evidence that defeated them, every registered question answered, and no necessary gap outstanding.
